name: Ocean Plastics Co., Ltd.
summary: Ocean Plastics Co., Ltd., established in Taipei City, Taiwan, in 1965, is a global enterprise specializing in the production and distribution of a diverse array of plastic-based goods. The company actively manufactures and sells PVC rigid pipes and sheets, serving markets in Taiwan, India, the United States, China, and other international regions. Their offerings extend to environmentally friendly, DMF-free polyurethane (PU) solutions. This category includes water-based polyurethane resin (WBPU), non-solvent prepolymer polyurethane resin, WBPU synthetic leather, and solvent-free prepolymerized PU leather. These versatile materials are integral to numerous industries, such as footwear, sports equipment (e.g., balls), home furnishings and decoration, consumer electronics, bag production, apparel/textiles, and various specialized applications. Additionally, Ocean Plastics provides wood plastic composites and a comprehensive range of PVC sheets. These PVC sheets encompass clear, flexible, semi-rigid films, and rigid variants, which are utilized across stationery, furniture, decorative items, packaging, and bespoke grade requirements. The company also produces essential PVC construction components, including piping for water supply, drainage, and sewage systems, along with CELLwood products. Furthermore, Ocean Plastics is a significant supplier of PVC raw materials. This comprises PVC compounds formulated for specific uses like bottle molding, IC tube extrusion, shrinkage film, modified clear PS, foam, conductive materials, black masterbatches, and medical-grade products. They also supply PVC resins, which are critical for manufacturing general rigid sheets and pipes, insulation, vinyl tapes, various PVC sheets and leather goods, blow-molded bottles, and IC tubes.
